option_relations.rationale: Post-viral keratitis is a general term and does not specifically relate to the provided leaf IDs.
Post-viral immune-mediated interstitial keratitis is a specific condition, but no direct relation to the provided leaf IDs can be established.
Chikungunya virus–associated keratitis directly relates to Chikungunya Virus Ocular Infection.
Chikungunya virus-induced bilateral stromal keratouveitis can be considered a subtype of Chikungunya Virus Ocular Infection.
